approval_source: Explicit user selection through the Tablet access questionnaire
scope: One cable-connected SSH compatibility/path-occupancy preflight. Read only platform metadata, the four listed file hashes after regular-file/symlink checks, and metadata for the eight listed target paths. Stop on mismatches, occupied proposed-owned paths, unexpected symlinks/types or failure. Record absent files without creating them.
excluded: Uploads, installation, configuration contents or writes, permissions changes and client replacement
Activation, Xochitl/service restart, reboot, firmware update or screenshots
Process scanning, process termination, removal, old helper execution or cleanup retry
